review.verified: Original transient assignment counts, exact donor and release ranks, FIFO front and back, native object/priority ownership, rank accessor and structurally consistent scalar ABI and GN.
review.limits: Source review only. The tests do not isolate which individual job is picked from multiple unassigned jobs or directly assert forwarded job priorities. FFI and bucket-scan costs are unmeasured. Platform configurations other than the scoped Windows output remain open.

validation: Warm Windows component net_unittests for the exact published candidate, -j4 and link-pool depth one. The prior auth run is being reconciled read-only against the same warm graph. Preserve that evidence before the next native build touches it.
